bio.text: Bill Hagerty was elected to the U.S. Senate from Tennessee in 2020 and is serving his first term.
Before the Senate he served as U.S. Ambassador to Japan, and from 2011 to 2014 he was Commissioner of the Tennessee Department of Economic and Community Development.
His business career began at the Boston Consulting Group, followed by work as a venture capital and private equity investor.
He is an Eagle Scout originally from Sumner County, Tennessee, and lives in Davidson County.
